targets.name: Summoning: Jade
targets.action: A crystal cocoon cracks and peels outward, summoning Jade, a fierce warrior, visibly into the battlefield.

targets.motion_axis: Cocoon shell parts upward/outward from central seam; summoned Jade warrior advances forward from golden light within.
targets.secondary_effect: Two heavy crystal shell panels peeling away from the opening, with sparse subordinate shard chips.
